40021307.author: पदार्थः
40021307.content: अर्जुनेन by Arjuna, विमुक्तः released, तु indeed, रावणः Ravana, राक्षसाधिपः the lord of Rakshasas, चचार roamed, पृथिवीम् earth, सर्वाम् all, अनिर्विण्णः undeterred, तथा thus, कृतः having been treated.

40021307.author: Translation
40021307.content: Indeed, Ravana, the lord of Rakshasas, having been released by Arjuna and treated in such a manner, roamed all over the earth undeterred.

40021308.author: पदार्थः
40021308.content: राक्षसम् a Rakshasa, वा or, मनुष्यम् a human, वा or, शृणुते hears, अयम् this (Ravana), बलाधिकम् superior in strength, रावणः Ravana, तम् him, समासाद्य having approached, युद्धे in battle, ह्वयति challenges, दर्पितः arrogant.

40021308.author: Translation
40021308.content: This arrogant Ravana, upon hearing of any Rakshasa or human superior in strength, would approach them and challenge them to battle.

40021309.author: पदार्थः
40021309.content: ततः Then, कदाचित् once, किष्किन्धां to Kishkindha, नगरीं city, वालिपालिताम् protected by Vali, गत्वा having gone, ह्वयति challenges, युद्धाय for battle, वालिनं Vali, हेममालिनम् adorned with a golden garland.

40021309.author: Translation
40021309.content: Then, once, having gone to the city of Kishkindha, which was protected by Vali, he challenged Vali, who was adorned with a golden garland, for battle.

40021310.author: पदार्थः
40021310.content: ततस्तु But then, वानरामात्यः the minister of monkeys, तारस्तारापिता Sushena (father of Tara), प्रभुः the powerful one, उवाच spoke, वानरः the monkey, वाक्यं words, युद्धप्रेप्सुम् to the one desirous of battle, उपागतम् who had come near.

40021310.author: Translation
40021310.content: But then, Sushena, the powerful minister of the monkeys and father of Tara, spoke words to the one who had come near, desirous of battle.

40021311.author: पदार्थः
40021311.content: राक्षसेन्द O king of Rakshasas, गतो gone, वाली Vali, यः who, ते to you, प्रतिबलो an equal opponent, भवेत् would be; को ऽन्यः who else, प्रमुखतः in front of, स्थातुं to stand, तव your, शक्तः capable, प्लवङ्गमः monkey (is there)?

40021311.author: Translation
40021311.content: O king of Rakshasas, Vali, who would be an equal opponent to you, has departed; what other monkey is capable of standing before you?

40021312.author: पदार्थः
40021312.content: चतुर्भ्यो ऽपि from all four, समुद्रेभ्यः oceans, सन्ध्याम् twilight prayers, अन्वास्य having performed, रावण O Ravana, इमं this, मुहूर्तम् moment, आयाति is coming, वाली Vali; तिष्ठ wait, मुहूर्तकम् for a moment.

40021312.author: Translation
40021312.content: O Ravana, Vali is returning in a moment, having performed his twilight prayers from all four oceans; wait for just a moment.

40021313.author: पदार्थः
40021313.content: एतान् these, अस्थिचयान् piles of bones, पश्य behold, यः which, एते these, शङ्खपाण्डुराः conch-white, युद्धार्थिनाम् of those desirous of battle, इमे these, राजन् O king, वानराधिपतेजसा by the might of the king of monkeys.

40021313.author: Translation
40021313.content: O king, behold these conch-white piles of bones, which are the remains of those who desired battle, vanquished by the might of the king of monkeys.

40021314.author: पदार्थः
40021314.content: यद्वा or if, अमृतरसः the nectar of immortality, पीतः has been drunk, त्वया by you, रावण O Ravana, राक्षस O demon, तदा then, वालिनम् Valin, आसाद्य having met, तदन्तम् its end, तव your, जीवितम् life.

40021314.author: Translation
40021314.content: O demon Ravana, even if you have drunk the nectar of immortality, your life will surely end once you encounter Valin.

40021315.author: पदार्थः
40021315.content: पश्य behold, इदानीम् now, जगच्चित्रम् the wonder of the world, इमम् this, विश्रवसः of Vishravas, सुत O son, इदम् this, मुहूर्तम् moment, तिष्ठस्व stay, दुर्लभम् rare, ते for you, भविष्यति it will be.

40021315.author: Translation
40021315.content: O son of Vishravas, behold this wonder of the world now, and wait for a moment, for such an opportunity will be rare for you in the future.

40021316.author: पदार्थः
40021316.content: अथवा or, त्वरसे you hasten, मर्तुम् to die, गच्छ go, दक्षिणसागरम् to the southern ocean, वालिनम् Valin, द्रक्ष्यसे you will see, तत्र there, भूमिस्थम् standing on the ground, इव like, पावकम् fire.

40021316.author: Translation
40021316.content: Alternatively, if you are eager to die, go to the southern ocean, where you will see Valin, who is like a fire standing on the earth.

40021317.author: पदार्थः
40021317.content: सः he, तु indeed, तारम् Tara, विनिर्भर्त्स्य having severely rebuked, रावणः Ravana, लोकरावणः the tormentor of the worlds, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka, तत् that, समारुह्य having ascended, प्रययौ he set off, दक्षिणार्णवम् to the southern ocean.

40021317.author: Translation
40021317.content: Indeed, that Ravana, the tormentor of the worlds, having severely rebuked Tara, ascended his Pushpaka chariot and set off towards the southern ocean.

40021318.author: पदार्थः
40021318.content: तत्र there, हेमगिरिप्रख्यम् resembling a golden mountain, तरुणार्कनिभाननम् whose face resembled the rising sun, रावणः Ravana, वालिनम् Valin, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सन्ध्योपासनतत्परम् intent on performing his twilight prayers.

40021318.author: Translation
40021318.content: There, Ravana saw Valin, who resembled a golden mountain with a face like the rising sun, intently engaged in his twilight prayers.

40021319.author: पदार्थः
40021319.content: पुष्पकात् from Pushpaka, अवरुह्य having descended, अथ then, रावणः Ravana, अञ्जनसन्निभः resembling collyrium, ग्रहीतुम् to seize, वालिनम् Valin, तूर्णं quickly, निःशब्दपदम् with silent steps, आव्रजत् approached.

40021319.author: Translation
40021319.content: Then, Ravana, dark like collyrium, descended from the Pushpaka chariot and quickly approached Valin with silent steps, intending to seize him.

40021320.author: पदार्थः
40021320.content: यदृच्छया by chance, तदा then, दृष्टः seen, वालिना by Valin, अपि also, सः that, रावणः Ravana, पापाभिप्रायवान् having evil intentions, दृष्ट्वा having seen, चकार made, न not, तु but, सम्भ्रमम् agitation.

40021320.author: Translation
40021320.content: By chance, Valin then saw that Ravana, who had evil intentions, but upon seeing him, Valin showed no agitation.

40021321.author: पदार्थः
40021321.content: शशम् a rabbit, आलक्ष्य having seen, सिंहः a lion, वा or, पन्नगम् a serpent, गरुडः Garuda, यथा just as, न not, चिन्तयति considers, तम् him, वाली Valin, रावणम् Ravana, पापनिश्चयम् evil-minded.

40021321.author: Translation
40021321.content: Just as a lion does not worry about a rabbit, or Garuda about a serpent, so Valin did not consider that evil-minded Ravana a threat.

40021322.author: पदार्थः
40021322.content: जिघृक्षमाणम् wishing to seize, आयान्तम् coming, रावणम् Ravana, पापचेतसम् evil-minded, कक्षावलम्बिनम् hanging from the armpit, कृत्वा having made, गमिष्ये I shall go, त्रीन् three, महार्णवान् great oceans.

40021322.author: Translation
40021322.content: Valin thought, "I will make this evil-minded Ravana, who is coming to seize me, hang from my armpit and then I shall traverse the three great oceans."

40021323.author: पदार्थः
40021323.content: द्रक्ष्यन्ति they will see, अरिम् the enemy, मम my, अङ्कस्थम् on the side, स्रंसत् slipping, ऊरु thighs, कर hands, अम्बरम् clothes, लम्बमानम् hanging, दशग्रीवम् Dashagriva, गरुडस्य of Garuda, इव like, पन्नगम् a serpent.

40021323.author: Translation
40021323.content: Valin further thought, "They will see my enemy Dashagriva, with his thighs, hands, and clothes slipping, hanging from my side like a serpent from Garuda."

40021324.author: पदार्थः
40021324.content: इत्येवं thus, मतिम् resolve, आस्थाय having adopted, वाली Vali, कर्णम् a secluded spot, उपाश्रितः having resorted to, जपन् chanting, वै indeed, नैगमान् Vedic, मन्त्रान् mantras, तस्थौ stood, पर्वतराट् king of mountains, इव like.

40021324.author: Translation
40021324.content: Vali, having adopted this resolve, resorted to a secluded spot and stood there, chanting Vedic mantras, appearing like the king of mountains.

40021325.author: पदार्थः
40021325.content: तौ those two, अन्योन्यम् each other, जिघृक्षन्तौ desiring to seize, हरि monkey (Vali), राक्षस demon (Ravana), पार्थिवौ kings, प्रयत्नवन्तौ making effort, तत्कर्म that action, ईहतुः they performed, बलदर्पितौ proud of their strength.

40021325.author: Translation
40021325.content: Those two kings, Vali and Ravana, both proud of their strength and desiring to seize each other, engaged in that struggle with great effort.

40021326.author: पदार्थः
40021326.content: हस्तग्राहम् within reach of hand, तु indeed, तम् him, मत्वा having perceived, पादशब्देन by the sound of footsteps, रावणम् Ravana, पराङ्मुखः facing away, अपि even, जग्राह seized, वाली Vali, सर्पम् a snake, इव like, अण्डजः a bird.

40021326.author: Translation
40021326.content: Vali, perceiving Ravana by the sound of his footsteps and considering him within reach, seized him even while facing away, just as a bird seizes a snake.

40021327.author: पदार्थः
40021327.content: ग्रहीतुकामम् desiring to seize (Vali), तम् him, गृह्य having seized, रक्षसाम् of the demons, ईश्वरम् lord, हरिः the monkey (Vali), खम् sky, उत्पपात flew up, वेगेन with speed, कृत्वा having made, कक्षावलम्बिनम् hanging from his armpit.

40021327.author: Translation
40021327.content: The monkey king Vali, having seized Ravana, the lord of demons, who had intended to capture him, swiftly flew up into the sky, holding Ravana hanging from his armpit.

40021328.author: पदार्थः
40021328.content: तम् him, च and, आपीडयमानम् being oppressed, तु indeed, वितुदन्तम् scratching, नखैः with nails, मुहुः repeatedly, जहार carried away, रावणम् Ravana, वाली Vali, पवनः wind, तोयदम् a cloud, यथा just as.

40021328.author: Translation
40021328.content: Vali carried away Ravana, who was being oppressed and repeatedly scratching him with his nails, just as the wind carries away a cloud.

40021329.author: पदार्थः
40021329.content: अथ then, ते those, राक्षसामात्याः Rakshasa ministers, ह्रियमाणं being carried away, दशाननम् Dashanana (Ravana), मुमोक्षयिषवः desiring to free, वालिं from Vali, रवमाणाः shouting, अभिद्रुताः rushed after.

40021329.author: Translation
40021329.content: Then, those Rakshasa ministers, seeing Dashanana being carried away by Vali, rushed after him, shouting, desiring to free their king.

40021330.author: पदार्थः
40021330.content: अन्वीयमानः being followed, तैः by them, वाली Vali, भ्राजते shone, अम्बरमध्यगः in the middle of the sky, अन्वीयमानः being followed, मेघौघैः by masses of clouds, अम्बरस्थः situated in the sky, इव like, अंशुमान् the sun.

40021330.author: Translation
40021330.content: Vali, being followed by those Rakshasas in the middle of the sky, shone like the sun in the sky being followed by masses of clouds.

40021331.author: पदार्थः
40021331.content: ते those, अशक्नुवन्तः being unable, सम्प्राप्तुं to reach, वालिनं Vali, राक्षसोत्तमाः the chief Rakshasas, तस्य his, बाहूरुवेगेन by the speed of his arms and thighs, परिश्रान्ताः exhausted, व्यवस्थिताः stopped.

40021331.author: Translation
40021331.content: Those chief Rakshasas, unable to reach Vali due to his immense speed, became exhausted and stopped.

40021332.author: पदार्थः
40021332.content: वालिमार्गात् from Vali's path, अपाक्रामन् moved away, पर्वतेन्द्रः even the king of mountains, हि indeed, गच्छतः of one going, किं पुनः what then, जीवितप्रेप्सुः one desiring to live, बिभ्रत् carrying, वै indeed, मांसशोणितम् flesh and blood.

40021332.author: Translation
40021332.content: Indeed, even a great mountain would move away from Vali's path as he flew, so how much more would those Rakshasas, who were mere beings of flesh and blood desiring to live, be unable to keep up.

40021333.author: पदार्थः
40021333.content: अपक्षिगणसम्पातान् where flocks of birds do not reach, वानरेन्द्रः the king of monkeys, महाजवः of great speed, क्रमशः successively, सागरान् the oceans, सर्वान् all, सन्ध्याकालम् the twilight time, अवन्दत worshipped.

40021333.author: Translation
40021333.content: The immensely swift king of monkeys, Vali, flew through regions where even flocks of birds could not reach, successively worshipping all the oceans as the twilight hour arrived.

40021334.author: पदार्थः
40021334.content: sabhājyamāno being honored, bhūtaiḥ tu by beings indeed, khaicaraiḥ by sky-dwellers, khaicarottamaḥ the best among sky-dwellers, paścimaṃ western, sāgaraṃ ocean, vālī Vali, hi indeed, ājagāma came, sarāvaṇaḥ with Ravana

40021334.author: Translation
40021334.content: Vali, the best among sky-dwellers, being honored by various celestial beings, indeed reached the western ocean with Ravana.

40021335.author: पदार्थः
40021335.content: tasmin there, sandhyām evening prayer, upāsitvā having performed, snātvā having bathed, japtvā having chanted, ca and, vānaraḥ the monkey, uttaraṃ northern, sāgaraṃ ocean, prāyāt proceeded, vahamānaḥ carrying, daśānanam Ravana

40021335.author: Translation
40021335.content: Having performed his evening prayers, bathed, and chanted mantras there, Vali, the monkey, proceeded to the northern ocean, still carrying Ravana.

40021336.author: पदार्थः
40021336.content: bahuyojanasāhasraṃ many thousands of yojanas, vahamānaḥ carrying, mahāhariḥ the great monkey, vāyuvacca like the wind, manovacca and like the mind, jagāma went, saha with, śatruṇā his enemy

40021336.author: Translation
40021336.content: The great monkey, carrying his enemy for many thousands of yojanas, traveled with the speed of wind and thought.

40021337.author: पदार्थः
40021337.content: uttare in the northern, sāgare ocean, sandhyām evening prayer, upāsitvā having performed, daśānanam Ravana, vahamānaḥ carrying, agamadvālī Vali went, pūrvaṃ eastern, vai indeed, sa he, mahodadhim great ocean

40021337.author: Translation
40021337.content: After performing his evening prayers in the northern ocean, Vali, still carrying Ravana, then proceeded to the eastern great ocean.

40021338.author: पदार्थः
40021338.content: tatra api there also, sandhyām evening prayer, anvāsya having performed, vāsaviḥ Vali, saharīśvaraḥ the lord of monkeys, kiṣkindhām Kishkindha, abhitaḥ towards, gṛhya having held, rāvaṇaṃ Ravana, punarāgamat returned again

40021338.author: Translation
40021338.content: Having performed his evening prayers there as well, Vali, the lord of monkeys, returned towards Kishkindha, still holding Ravana.

40021339.author: पदार्थः
40021339.content: चतुर्ष्वपि in all four, समुद्रेषु oceans, सन्ध्याम् twilight prayers, अन्वास्य having performed, वानरः the monkey (Bali), रावणोद्वहनश्रान्तः tired from carrying Ravana, किष्किन्धोपवने in the pleasure grove of Kishkindha, अपतत् fell down.

40021339.author: Translation
40021339.content: After performing his twilight prayers in all four oceans, the monkey (Bali), exhausted from carrying Ravana, landed in the pleasure grove of Kishkindha.

40021340.author: पदार्थः
40021340.content: रावणम् Ravana, तु indeed, मुमोच released, अथ then, स्वकक्षात् from his armpit, कपिसत्तमः the best of monkeys (Bali), कुतः from where, त्वम् you, इति thus, च and, उवाच said, प्रहसन् laughing, रावणम् to Ravana, मुहुः repeatedly.

40021340.author: Translation
40021340.content: Then, the best of monkeys (Bali) released Ravana from his armpit and, laughing repeatedly, asked Ravana, "Where are you from?"

40021341.author: पदार्थः
40021341.content: विस्मयम् astonishment, तु indeed, महत् great, गत्वा having experienced, श्रमलोलनिरीक्षणः whose gaze was unsteady due to fatigue, राक्षसेन्द्रः the king of Rakshasas (Ravana), हरीन्द्रम् to the king of monkeys (Bali), तम् that, इदम् this, वचनम् word, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40021341.author: Translation
40021341.content: Having experienced great astonishment and with his gaze unsteady from fatigue, the king of Rakshasas (Ravana) spoke these words to that king of monkeys (Bali).

40021342.author: पदार्थः
40021342.content: वानरेन्द्र O king of monkeys, महेन्द्राभ O one resembling Mahendra, राक्षसेन्द्रः the king of Rakshasas, अस्मि I am, रावणः Ravana, युद्धेप्सुः desirous of battle, इह here, सम्प्राप्तः arrived, सः that (desire for battle), च and, अद्य today, आसादितः obtained, त्वया by you.

40021342.author: Translation
40021342.content: Ravana addressed Bali, saying, "O king of monkeys, resembling Mahendra, I am Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, who arrived here desirous of battle, and that desire has been fulfilled by you today."

40021343.author: पदार्थः
40021343.content: अहो Oh!, बलम् strength, अहो Oh!, वीर्यम् valor, अहो Oh!, गाम्भीर्यम् profundity, एव indeed, च and, येन by whom, अहम् I, पशुवत् like an animal, गृह्य having been seized, भ्रामितः made to wander, चतुरः four, अर्णवान् oceans.

40021343.author: Translation
40021343.content: Ravana exclaimed, "Oh, what strength, what valor, and what profundity, by which I was seized like an animal and carried around all four oceans!"

40021344.author: पदार्थः
40021344.content: एवम् thus, अश्रान्तवत् tirelessly, वीर O hero, शीघ्रमेव very quickly, महार्णवान् the great oceans, माम् me, च and, एव indeed, उद्वहमानः carrying, तु indeed, कः who, अन्यः other, वीरः hero, क्रमिष्यति will cross.

40021344.author: Translation
40021344.content: O hero, who else but you, carrying me and the great oceans, will swiftly and tirelessly traverse them?

40021345.author: पदार्थः
40021345.content: त्रयाणाम् of three, एव indeed, भूतानाम् of beings, गतिः speed, एषा this, प्लवङ्गम O monkey, मनः mind, अनिलः wind, सुपर्णानाम् of Suparna (Garuda), तव your, च and, अत्र in this, न not, संशयः doubt.

40021345.author: Translation
40021345.content: O monkey, this speed belongs to only three beings: the mind, the wind, and Suparna (Garuda), and there is no doubt that it also belongs to you.

40021346.author: पदार्थः
40021346.content: सः that, अहम् I, दृष्टबलः one whose strength has been seen, तुभ्यम् by you, इच्छामि I desire, हरिपुङ्गव O best of monkeys, त्वया with you, सह together, चिरम् for a long time, सख्यम् friendship, सुस्निग्धम् very affectionate, पावकाग्रतः in front of fire.

40021346.author: Translation
40021346.content: O best of monkeys, having witnessed your strength, I desire to establish a very firm and lasting friendship with you in the presence of fire.

40021347.author: पदार्थः
40021347.content: दाराः wives, पुत्राः sons, पुरम् city, राष्ट्रम् kingdom, भोगाः enjoyments, आच्छादनम् clothing, भोजनम् food, सर्वम् all, एव indeed, अविभक्तम् undivided, नौ for us two, भविष्यति will be, हरीश्वर O lord of monkeys.

40021347.author: Translation
40021347.content: O lord of monkeys, our wives, sons, city, kingdom, enjoyments, clothing, and food, all will indeed be undivided between us.

40021348.author: पदार्थः
40021348.content: ततः then, प्रज्वालयित्वा having kindled, अग्निम् fire, तौ those two, उभौ both, हरी the monkey, राक्षसौ and the Rakshasa, भ्रातृत्वम् brotherhood, उपसम्पन्नौ having attained, परिष्वज्य having embraced, परस्परम् each other.

40021348.author: Translation
40021348.content: Then, having kindled a fire, both the monkey (Hanuman) and the Rakshasa (Vibhishana) established their brotherhood and embraced each other.

40021349.author: पदार्थः
40021349.content: अन्योन्यं each other, लम्बितकरौ with hands clasped, ततः then, तौ those two, हरिराक्षसौ the monkey and the demon, किष्किन्धां to Kishkindha, विशतुः entered, हृष्टौ delighted, सिंहौ two lions, गिरिगुहाम् a mountain cave, इव like,

40021349.author: Translation
40021349.content: Then, those two, the monkey (Vali) and the demon (Ravana), with hands clasped, joyfully entered Kishkindha, just like two lions entering a mountain cave.

40021350.author: पदार्थः
40021350.content: सः he, तत्र there, मासम् for a month, उषितः having stayed, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, इव like, रावणः Ravana, अमात्यैः by ministers, आगतैः who had arrived, नीतः was led away, त्रैलोक्य of the three worlds, उत्सादन destruction, अर्थिभिः desiring,

40021350.author: Translation
40021350.content: Ravana, having stayed there for a month like Sugriva, was then led away by his ministers who had arrived, desiring the destruction of the three worlds.

40021351.author: पदार्थः
40021351.content: एवम् thus, एतत् this, पुरा formerly, वृत्तम् happened, वालिना by Vali, रावणः Ravana, प्रभो O Lord, धर्षितः humiliated, च and, कृतः made, च and, अपि also, भ्राता a brother, पावक fire, सन्निधौ in the presence of,

40021351.author: Translation
40021351.content: O Lord, thus did this happen formerly: Ravana was humiliated by Vali and also made his brother in the presence of fire.

40021352.author: पदार्थः
40021352.content: बलम् strength, अप्रतिमम् unequalled, राम O Rama, वालिनः of Vali, अभवत् was, उत्तमम् supreme, सः he, अपि even, त्वया by you, विनिर्दग्धः completely destroyed, शलभः a moth, वह्निना by fire, यथा just as,

40021352.author: Translation
40021352.content: O Rama, Vali possessed supreme and unequalled strength, yet even he was completely destroyed by you, just as a moth is consumed by fire. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुस्त्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 34 ।। Thus ends the thirty-fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
